game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Snow Fort, a snowball fort: the firewood keeper must handle yeti raiders while practicing functions. Core idea – Library Builder: Combine small functions into a reusable library the firewood keeper calls throughout the level.
theme: Snowy Hold – Snow Fort: a snowball fort
core_gameplay_loop: In Snow Fort, repeat each round: Combine small functions into a reusable library the firewood keeper calls throughout the level. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the library value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the hearth fire using at most 11 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The hearth fire reached with actions_used <= 11.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 11 before the hearth fire is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 2 (intro tier): Library Builder
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Library Builder' (Week 6 slot 14), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Snow Fort'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how library changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against yeti raiders in Snow Fort.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The hearth fire reached with actions_used <= 11.
